BiblicalUsage: Once, and it is Delilah wearing Samson down: she pressed him daily with her words, and urged him, so that his soul was vexed unto death. The word is pressure applied day after day until the strongest man alive gives up the secret of his strength.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for pressing carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the warning in it, that a will can be worn down a little at a time until it breaks.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
